name: AR_STATEMENTS_HISTORY_ALL
description: The history of every customer statement that you generate

columns.name: LINE_CLUSTER_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the line cluster

columns.name: SEND_TO_ADDRESS_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the send-to address, foreign key reference to the RA_ADDRESSES_ALL table

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the customer, foreign key reference to the RA_CUSTOMERS table

columns.name: STATEMENT_DATE
columns.description: Date when the statement was generated

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code for the currency of the transaction

columns.name: FINANCE_CHARGES
columns.description: Amount of finance charges that the customer owes

columns.name: TOTAL_AMOUNT_DUE
columns.description: Total amount due

columns.name: SITE_USE_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the site use, foreign key reference to the RA_SITE_USES_ALL table

columns.name: STATEMENT_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates if the statement that is generated is sent to a statement or a bill-to site

columns.name: BILL_TO_LOCATION
columns.description: Location description of a bill-to site

columns.name: CREDIT_BALANCE_STATEMENTS
columns.description: Y if credit balance statements are sent to this site, otherwise N

columns.name: CUST_CUSTOMER_PROFILE_ID
columns.description: Customer level profile identifier, foreign key reference to the AR_CUSTOMER_PROFILES table

columns.name: MIN_STATEMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Minimum statement amount before statements are printed

columns.name: MONTHLY_INTEREST_RATE
columns.description: Interest rate defined for the customer at the statement site. When there is no statement site, the rate comes from the bill to site.

columns.name: SITE_CUSTOMER_PROFILE_ID
columns.description: Site level profile identifier, foreign key reference to the AR_CUSTOMER_PROFILES table

columns.name: IS_IT_A_REPRINT
columns.description: Y if the statement has been reprinted, otherwise N

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: STATEMENT_CYCLE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the Statement Cycle

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REMIT_TO_ADDRESS_SEQ_ID
columns.description: Remit-to address sequence identifier.
